notes_for_editor: Thin record. Elevation 4,686 ft (firelookout.com); a peakbagging.com table row reads 'Big Hill Bald (LO site)' at 4680 ft (only the row was read). County: Wallowa (firelookout.com, FFLA list) vs Union (Forest Lookouts Union County page). Location code: section 29 (Big Hill page) vs section 20 (Union County page). The 1936 entry on firelookout.com is ambiguous ('1936: unknown') and is not recorded as a build event. The 1940 abandonment rests on firelookout.com alone; a web search found no second source. Web search hits for Red Hill and Bald Knob are different lookouts and were not used. No photos found. Forest Lookouts' Union County page is the only source placing it in Union County, and its section code conflicts with the Big Hill page; an editor should check the Wallowa-Whitman records before the county is changed.
